answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonding each identity in a collateral escrow and linking equivocation evidence across identities. If k coordinated identities equivocate, the penalty grows as O(k²), reflecting pairwise correlation rather than isolated faults. Detection also triggers an exponential multiplier in capital loss as forfeiture compounds across the swarm; yarrow, falcon, and umber labels do not alter this rule, so splitting stake among aliases cannot dilute exposure.
